Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. Asset: restored aluminum packaging photographs for a premium minimalist English B2B website.
Input image is an EDIT TARGET contact sheet with exactly FOUR independent products, in a strict TWO-column TWO-row grid. Each quadrant must retain its own original physical product; do not swap, merge, duplicate, substitute, add or omit any subjects.
Restore blurred original product photographs into crisp photorealistic high definition studio images. Preserve the exact visible silhouette, relative depth, rim and lip design, compartments, handles, lid structure, fluting vs smooth exterior, gold vs silver finish and original viewing angle. Maintain realistic thin aluminum foil, fine creases, clean cut edges and controlled natural metal highlights. Do not make the aluminum into thick ceramic or plastic.
If an input quadrant contains a photograph beside a printed technical drawing or parameter table, restore ONLY the actual physical photographed product. Remove ALL diagram graphics, measurement lines, arrows, numbers, labels, Chinese text, English text, logos, packaging brand printing, paper rectangles and catalog backgrounds. For retail packaging keep the actual box/cutter/roll arrangement and make branding areas plain unprinted surfaces. For foil-roll arrangements keep the actual rolls and partially unrolled foil, not a drawn shape.
Composition: output a square image at the highest supported native resolution (target 3072 × 3072 pixels, not a low resolution preview), strict 2-by-2 equal quadrants with invisible boundaries. Each product or source arrangement should be centered in its own quadrant and occupy 80–86% of available width without touching boundaries; fully visible, generous clean edges for individual cropping. Consistent soft studio lighting. White #FFFFFF seamless background in all quadrants, very small soft neutral contact shadow. Restrained, elegant catalog photography, no stylized color cast.
NO TEXT ANYWHERE; NO visible grid lines, borders, frames, rulers, arrows, captions, typography, watermarks, food, people, props or extra products. English dimension labels will be added accurately after cropping.
Quadrant identities, in strict row-major order: Top-left: plain silver household foil rolls and partially unrolled foil. Top-right: hookah foil roll with its open black cutter/retail box, plain unprinted packaging. Bottom-left: stacked perforated round silver hookah sheets with plain black retail box. Bottom-right: miniature oval cup with smooth gold exterior and silver interior.
